lessons.title: What is Kotlin?
lessons.content:
Kotlin is a modern, statically typed programming language developed by JetBrains. It runs on the JVM and can also compile to JavaScript, Native binaries, and WebAssembly through Kotlin Multiplatform.

Why Kotlin?
Kotlin was created to solve many shortcomings of Java while remaining fully interoperable with existing Java code. It provides concise syntax, null safety, extension functions, coroutines, and many productivity features.

Real World Analogy
Think of Java as a reliable family car. Kotlin is the latest model built on the same platform but equipped with automatic transmission, advanced safety systems, and modern conveniences. You can still drive on the same roads, but with much less effort.

Android Usage
Google announced Kotlin as an official Android language in 2017. Today, Jetpack Compose, Coroutines, Hilt, Room, and most modern Android libraries are designed with Kotlin first.

Real Usage
Companies such as Google, Netflix, Uber, Pinterest, Trello, and many startups use Kotlin in production for Android apps, backend services, and multiplatform development.

Summary
• Modern programming language
• Fully interoperable with Java
• Concise and expressive
• Official Android language
• Supports Multiplatform development

Interview Questions
1. Who developed Kotlin?
2. Why did Google choose Kotlin?
3. Can Kotlin call Java code?
4. What platforms does Kotlin support?

Cheat Sheet
Developer : JetBrains
Released : 2016
Official Android Language : Yes
Null Safe : Yes
Supports JVM : Yes
Supports Android : Yes
Supports iOS : Yes (KMP)
Supports Web : Yes

lessons.title: Why Learn Kotlin?
lessons.content:
Kotlin has become one of the most popular programming languages because it increases developer productivity while reducing bugs.

Benefits
• Less boilerplate code
• Null safety
• Better readability
• Coroutines for asynchronous programming
• Extension functions
• Smart casts
• Data classes
• Functional programming support

Android Usage
Almost every modern Android project uses Kotlin. Jetpack Compose is written specifically for Kotlin and uses many Kotlin language features like higher-order functions, lambdas, and extension functions.

Career Perspective
Learning Kotlin opens opportunities in Android development, backend development with Ktor or Spring Boot, Kotlin Multiplatform, desktop applications, and interview preparation.

Summary
Kotlin is easier to write, easier to maintain, and safer than Java in many scenarios.

lessons.title: Kotlin Roadmap
lessons.content:
This course is designed to take you from absolute beginner to advanced Kotlin developer.

Roadmap
1. Learn Kotlin Basics
2. Master Control Flow
3. Understand Functions
4. Learn Object-Oriented Programming
5. Explore Collections
6. Functional Programming
7. Advanced Kotlin Features
8. Coroutines
9. Flow
10. Android with Kotlin
11. Interview Preparation

Advice
Do not skip exercises. Every lesson builds on the previous one. Practice each concept by writing code yourself before moving to the next lesson.
